entries.dialogueText: “What can she do when Frens couldn't do anything?”

entries.dialogueText: "Hypothetically, what if she were to meet the same fate as Frens?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern

entries.dialogueText: “Don't you still have your investigation going? Maybe they'll dig up some dirt on her."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
